HEXAGON.Champ.DilemmeAide: What this Motivation costs the character
HEXAGON.Pool.Engager: Add this Trait to the pool
HEXAGON.Pool.Aide: Click a rank to add that Trait to the pool.
HEXAGON.Avertissement.TraitSansActeur: This Trait has no owner: open it from a character sheet.
HEXAGON.Champ.SpecialitesRang0: Dormant while the rank sits at 0.
HEXAGON.Avertissement.AudaceEpuisee: No Daring left for this roll.
HEXAGON.Reglage.InitiativePartageeAide: One roll per side of extras. Player characters always use the shared pool.
HEXAGON.Initiative.ChoisirLeader: Pick the scene's leader: whoever fits the situation best, not necessarily the team's chief.
HEXAGON.Initiative.AideLeader: The leader contributes one Trait of each type, consistent with an initiative test.
HEXAGON.Initiative.AideJoueurs: Every other player adds one and only one Trait from their character.
HEXAGON.Initiative.AidePot: Share the Successes among the characters. Each also keeps their automatic Success.
HEXAGON.Initiative.RangCalcul: Automatic Success plus the share taken from the pool
HEXAGON.Initiative.RappelAutomatique: Every character keeps one automatic Success of their own, guaranteeing they can act.
HEXAGON.Initiative.MainIncomplete: The leader must contribute one Trait of each type.
HEXAGON.Initiative.MainVide: The hand adds up to no dice.
HEXAGON.Initiative.PassezParLaPhase: Player characters take their rank from the shared pool: use the initiative phase.
HEXAGON.Initiative.AideFraction: A character may split their rank to act several times: enter ranks that are all different and add up to their rank. A rank of 6 gives 4 and 2, or 3, 2 and 1 — never 3 and 3.
HEXAGON.Initiative.FractionEntiers: Ranks must be whole numbers above zero.
HEXAGON.Initiative.FractionDoublons: Two identical ranks are not allowed.
HEXAGON.Initiative.FractionSomme: The total must equal the starting rank.
HEXAGON.Initiative.TourClos: Turn closed: ranks sit at zero until the next share-out.
HEXAGON.HommesDeMain.OppositionAide: Half the Threat rounded up. The difficulty to beat, and the group's initiative rank.
HEXAGON.HommesDeMain.MenaceAide: Group size, 1 to 12. At zero the group is beaten, scattered or fleeing.
HEXAGON.HommesDeMain.FusionnerAide: Threat values add up, capped at 10. The absorbed group drops to zero.
HEXAGON.SecondCouteau.MenaceAide: The NPC's vitality and resolve, 1 to 12. At zero they are out of the fight or fleeing.
HEXAGON.SecondCouteau.OppositionAide: Set freely by the GM. The difficulty to beat, and the NPC's initiative rank.
HEXAGON.SecondCouteau.Vaincu: NPC beaten, out of the fight or fleeing.
HEXAGON.Initiative.EquipeAide: Tick the characters taking part in the action scene. Only they join the collective hand and receive a share of the pool.
HEXAGON.Initiative.AucunHeros: No player character in this encounter.
